experiments.scope: A tighter variant of completion step K5 (cell-respecting E13/E15 draws, caps 2^14 and 2^8) on fixed accepted matches: the prefix of the stored pair, of relaxed-run-1, and of the published match. Each organizer seed drives the E13/E15 draws through SHAKE-256.
experiments.hypothesis: For these accepted matches the completion step succeeds for each organizer seed, and every returned pair is a distinct full sha256-r31 collision.
